title: Formalizing Fermat's Last Theorem
summary: Anthropic researchers are working on formalizing Fermat's Last Theorem using the Lean proof assistant, creating machine-verifiable mathematical proofs for one of mathematics' most celebrated results originally proven by Andrew Wiles in 1994.
problem_solved: Creates machine-verifiable, error-free formal proofs of one of the most complex mathematical theorems ever proven.
why_valuable: Ensures mathematical rigor by providing independently verifiable proofs that eliminate human error in complex reasoning, advancing the intersection of AI and pure mathematics.
